meanings.exampleEn: She delved into the scientific papers before writing her report.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在写报告前钻研了那些科学论文。

meanings.exampleEn: The expedition delved into the history of the abandoned village.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次考察深入探索了这个废弃村庄的历史。

meanings.exampleEn: Please tell me the exact time of the meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 请告诉我会议的确切时间。

meanings.exampleEn: The question elicited a thoughtful response from the class.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个问题引出了全班经过深思熟虑的回答。

meanings.exampleEn: They serve traditional food at the festival.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们在节日里供应传统食物。

meanings.exampleEn: The story is part of a traditional oral history.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个故事属于口传历史的一部分。

meanings.exampleEn: The project failed because it lacked funding.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个项目因缺乏资金而失败。

meanings.exampleEn: A regent governed the country until the young king grew up.
meanings.exampleZh: 一位摄政者治理国家，直到年轻的国王成年。

meanings.exampleEn: The small company burgeoned into a major technology firm.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家小公司迅速成长为一家大型科技企业。

meanings.exampleEn: New ideas began to burgeon after the workshop.
meanings.exampleZh: 研讨会后，新想法开始蓬勃发展。

meanings.exampleEn: The two students argued about which plan was better.
meanings.exampleZh: 两名学生争论哪个计划更好。

meanings.exampleEn: The researcher argues that sleep improves memory.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员论证睡眠能改善记忆。

meanings.exampleEn: The report argues for stricter safety rules.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告主张制定更严格的安全规则。

meanings.exampleEn: I could barely hear the speaker from the back row.
meanings.exampleZh: 我在后排几乎听不见演讲者的声音。

meanings.exampleEn: She barely finished the assignment before the deadline.
meanings.exampleZh: 她勉强在截止时间前完成了作业。

meanings.exampleEn: The company has a clear hierarchy of managers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司有明确的管理层级。

meanings.exampleEn: Students can ask their teachers for guidance.
meanings.exampleZh: 学生可以向老师寻求指导。

meanings.exampleEn: Our new teacher is friendly and easy-going.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们的新老师友好随和。

meanings.exampleEn: An electrical fault caused the lights to go out.
meanings.exampleZh: 电路故障导致灯熄灭。

meanings.exampleEn: She keeps an electronic copy of the report.
meanings.exampleZh: 她保存了一份报告的电子版。

meanings.exampleEn: He studied philosophy at university.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在大学学习哲学。

meanings.exampleEn: Her philosophy is to treat everyone with respect.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的人生理念是尊重每一个人。

meanings.exampleEn: He receives treatment for chronic back pain.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因慢性背痛接受治疗。

meanings.exampleEn: A short journey to work is desirable for many people.
meanings.exampleZh: 对许多人来说，通勤时间短很有吸引力。

meanings.exampleEn: A consortium of banks financed the bridge.
meanings.exampleZh: 一个由多家银行组成的财团为这座桥提供了资金。

meanings.exampleEn: Buckle your seat belt before the car starts moving.
meanings.exampleZh: 汽车启动前请扣好安全带。

meanings.exampleEn: The metal bar buckled under the heavy load.
meanings.exampleZh: 金属杆在重压下弯曲了。

meanings.exampleEn: The plastic container buckled in the heat.
meanings.exampleZh: 塑料容器在高温下变形了。

meanings.exampleEn: We ordered a vegetable curry for dinner.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们晚餐点了一份蔬菜咖喱。

meanings.exampleEn: The advertisement contained a subliminal message.
meanings.exampleZh: 这则广告包含一条潜意识信息。

meanings.exampleEn: The visitors entered a quiet chamber filled with old maps.
meanings.exampleZh: 参观者走进了一间摆满旧地图的安静房间。

meanings.exampleEn: The divers discovered a hidden chamber beneath the lake.
meanings.exampleZh: 潜水员在湖下发现了一个隐藏的洞穴。

meanings.exampleEn: Air was trapped inside the chamber of the machine.
meanings.exampleZh: 空气被困在机器的腔室里。

meanings.exampleEn: Frequent practice is the best way to improve pronunciation.
meanings.exampleZh: 频繁练习是提高发音的最好方法。

meanings.exampleEn: Headaches are a common symptom of dehydration.
meanings.exampleZh: 头痛是脱水的常见症状。

meanings.exampleEn: The once quiet port became a prosperous trading centre.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个曾经安静的港口变成了繁荣的贸易中心。

meanings.exampleEn: The prosperous family donated money to the local school.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个富裕的家庭向当地学校捐了钱。

meanings.exampleEn: The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the budget.
meanings.exampleZh: 会议的目的是讨论预算。

meanings.exampleEn: What is the purpose of this tool?
meanings.exampleZh: 这个工具有什么用途？

meanings.exampleEn: The shop offers a wide variety of teas.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家商店提供种类繁多的茶。

meanings.exampleEn: The course gains strength from the variety of its topics.
meanings.exampleZh: 这门课程因主题的多样性而更有吸引力。

meanings.exampleEn: A little variety makes a daily routine less boring.
meanings.exampleZh: 一点变化能让日常生活不那么乏味。

meanings.exampleEn: The city has welcomed immigration from many countries.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座城市接纳了来自许多国家的移民。

meanings.exampleEn: Immigration to the region increased after new jobs were created.
meanings.exampleZh: 新工作出现后，移居该地区的人数增加了。

meanings.exampleEn: The park protects the natural landscape along the river.
meanings.exampleZh: 公园保护着河流沿岸的自然景观。

meanings.exampleEn: It is natural to feel nervous before an important interview.
meanings.exampleZh: 在重要面试前感到紧张是正常的。

meanings.exampleEn: I bet that our team will win the match.
meanings.exampleZh: 我打赌我们队会赢得比赛。

meanings.exampleEn: He placed a small bet on the race.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在比赛上押了一小笔赌注。

meanings.exampleEn: Consumers can compare prices online.
meanings.exampleZh: 消费者可以在网上比较价格。

meanings.exampleEn: A physician examined the patient at the clinic.
meanings.exampleZh: 一名医生在诊所为病人做了检查。

meanings.exampleEn: The two boxes are equal in size.
meanings.exampleZh: 这两个盒子的大小相等。

meanings.exampleEn: Three times four equals twelve.
meanings.exampleZh: 三乘四等于十二。

meanings.exampleEn: She is equal to the challenge of leading the team.
meanings.exampleZh: 她能够胜任带领团队的挑战。

meanings.exampleEn: The coastal resort attracts visitors in summer.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个海滨度假胜地在夏季吸引游客。

meanings.exampleEn: The two sides resorted to negotiation to solve the dispute.
meanings.exampleZh: 双方诉诸谈判来解决争端。

meanings.exampleEn: Her leadership helped the team overcome the crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的领导能力帮助团队克服了危机。

meanings.exampleEn: The leadership announced a new plan.
meanings.exampleZh: 领导层宣布了一项新计划。

meanings.exampleEn: The policy aims to improve equity in education.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项政策旨在促进教育公平。

meanings.exampleEn: Archaeologists excavated pottery from the ancient settlement.
meanings.exampleZh: 考古学家从古代聚落中挖掘出陶器。

meanings.exampleEn: Workers excavated a tunnel through the mountain.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们在山中开凿了一条隧道。

meanings.exampleEn: The country generates electricity from nuclear power.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个国家利用核能发电。

meanings.exampleEn: Trust and mutual respect are essential to friendship.
meanings.exampleZh: 信任和相互尊重对友谊至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The map shows the population density of each region.
meanings.exampleZh: 这张地图显示了各地区的人口密度。

meanings.exampleEn: The city invested in a massive transport project.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座城市投资了一项大型交通工程。

meanings.exampleEn: I called to congratulate her on passing the exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 我打电话祝贺她通过考试。

meanings.exampleEn: Her companion waited for her outside the station.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的同伴在车站外等她。

meanings.exampleEn: The officials were accused of trying to rig the election.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些官员被指控企图操纵选举。

meanings.exampleEn: They rigged a temporary shelter with a sheet of canvas.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们用一块帆布搭建了临时住所。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee welcomed input from local residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会欢迎当地居民提出意见。

meanings.exampleEn: The software checks each input before saving it.
meanings.exampleZh: 软件在保存前会检查每条输入信息。

meanings.exampleEn: The delay was merely a minor inconvenience.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次延误只不过是一个小小的不便。

meanings.exampleEn: The mentor imparted useful skills to the new staff.
meanings.exampleZh: 导师向新员工传授了有用的技能。

meanings.exampleEn: The guide imparted the latest travel advice to us.
meanings.exampleZh: 导游把最新的旅行建议告知了我们。

meanings.exampleEn: The sunlight imparted a warm colour to the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 阳光赋予房间一种温暖的色彩。

meanings.exampleEn: You may forfeit your deposit if you cancel late.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果取消得太晚，你可能会失去押金。

meanings.exampleEn: The illegal goods were forfeited to the government.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些违禁品被没收并交给了政府。

meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise can counteract some effects of stress.
meanings.exampleZh: 定期锻炼可以抵消压力的某些影响。

meanings.exampleEn: Good ventilation helps keep the room dry.
meanings.exampleZh: 良好的通风有助于保持房间干燥。

meanings.exampleEn: She joined an intermediate English class.
meanings.exampleZh: 她参加了一个中级英语班。

meanings.exampleEn: The intermediate stage took several months.
meanings.exampleZh: 中间阶段持续了几个月。

meanings.exampleEn: The poem explores the idea of eternal love.
meanings.exampleZh: 这首诗探讨了永恒之爱的主题。

meanings.exampleEn: The invasion forced many families to leave their homes.
meanings.exampleZh: 入侵迫使许多家庭离开家园。

meanings.exampleEn: It was raining; nevertheless, they continued their walk.
meanings.exampleZh: 当时正在下雨，尽管如此，他们还是继续散步。

meanings.exampleEn: We celebrated her birthday with a family dinner.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们举行家庭晚餐庆祝她的生日。

meanings.exampleEn: The exhibition celebrates the work of local artists.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场展览颂扬当地艺术家的作品。

meanings.exampleEn: Her inspiring speech encouraged the students to keep trying.
meanings.exampleZh: 她鼓舞人心的演讲激励学生们继续努力。

meanings.exampleEn: Regular attendance is important for this course.
meanings.exampleZh: 按时出勤对这门课程很重要。

meanings.exampleEn: Attendance at the concert exceeded expectations.
meanings.exampleZh: 音乐会的出席人数超过了预期。

meanings.exampleEn: The afternoon workshop is optional.
meanings.exampleZh: 下午的研讨会可以自愿参加。

meanings.exampleEn: The cut should heal within a few days.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个伤口应该在几天内愈合。

meanings.exampleEn: The conversation helped heal the division between them.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次谈话帮助弥合了他们之间的分歧。

meanings.exampleEn: The new ramp enables wheelchair users to enter the library.
meanings.exampleZh: 新坡道使轮椅使用者能够进入图书馆。

meanings.exampleEn: Workers dismantled the old bridge carefully.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们小心地拆除了旧桥。

meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to dismantle the organisation.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府决定解散这个组织。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers receive their wages every Friday.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们每周五领取工资。

meanings.exampleEn: Snow covered the mountain landscape.
meanings.exampleZh: 白雪覆盖着山间的景色。

meanings.exampleEn: The river has shaped the landscape over thousands of years.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条河历经数千年塑造了这里的地貌。

meanings.exampleEn: Music can express emotion without words.
meanings.exampleZh: 音乐不需要语言就能表达情感。

meanings.exampleEn: The countries joined a commonwealth to cooperate on trade.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些国家加入了一个共同体，以便开展贸易合作。

meanings.exampleEn: The school sends a newsletter to parents each month.
meanings.exampleZh: 学校每月向家长发送一份简报。

meanings.exampleEn: She published an article in a scientific periodical.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在一本科学期刊上发表了一篇文章。

meanings.exampleEn: The equipment requires periodical inspection.
meanings.exampleZh: 该设备需要定期检查。

meanings.exampleEn: The receptionist asked me to wait in the lobby.
meanings.exampleZh: 接待员请我在大厅等候。

meanings.exampleEn: The airport increased security after the incident.
meanings.exampleZh: 事件发生后，机场加强了安保。

meanings.exampleEn: A stable income can provide a sense of security.
meanings.exampleZh: 稳定的收入可以带来安全感。

meanings.exampleEn: She used a clip to hold the papers together.
meanings.exampleZh: 她用夹子把文件夹在一起。

meanings.exampleEn: We watched a short clip from the film.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们看了一段电影片段。

meanings.exampleEn: He clipped a small branch from the tree.
meanings.exampleZh: 他从树上剪下一根小树枝。

meanings.exampleEn: Work on the new hospital is proceeding apace.
meanings.exampleZh: 新医院的建设工作正在快速推进。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer expects a higher yield this year.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民预计今年的产量会更高。

meanings.exampleEn: The research yielded useful results.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项研究产生了有用的结果。

meanings.exampleEn: Neither side was willing to yield during the talks.
meanings.exampleZh: 谈判期间双方都不愿让步。

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher made sure the competition was fair.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师确保比赛是公平的。
